existing.headline: Community holds vigil for 9-year-old killed in East Midway Road dirt bike crash
existing.teaser: The vigil followed the East Midway Road crash involving a FedEx truck that killed a 9-year-old and injured a 12-year-old.
existing.body: Family and community members gathered after the dirt bike collision with a FedEx truck on East Midway Road in St. Lucie County.

incoming.headline: 12-year-old injured in East Midway Road dirt bike crash released from hospital
incoming.teaser: The child survived the FedEx truck crash that killed a 9-year-old.
incoming.body: The July collision happened on East Midway Road in St. Lucie County.

existing.headline: Deputies rescue about 80 cats from Stuart home
existing.teaser: Martin County deputies described it as an animal hoarding case.
existing.body: More than 70 animals were removed from the Stuart property.

incoming.headline: Stuart woman arrested after 80 cats removed in hoarding case
incoming.teaser: The Martin County Sheriff's Office announced an arrest after deputies rescued the animals.
incoming.body: Officials called it one of the county's worst animal hoarding cases.

existing.headline: St. Lucie firefighters fired after hazing investigation
existing.teaser: The fire district terminated employees after an internal investigation.
existing.body: The case involved allegations of hazing and discipline within the St. Lucie County Fire District.

incoming.headline: Union challenges St. Lucie firefighter terminations in hazing case
incoming.teaser: A police report and union response raise questions about the discipline.
incoming.body: The dispute concerns the same St. Lucie County Fire District investigation.
